What you receive

  • A letter every quarter

    News from the field, written by the team, with names and faces shared only with consent.

  • Your impact, in numbers

    A clear summary: baskets handed out, outreach rounds, children supported thanks to the Circle.

  • The prayer chain

    Receive the association’s prayer requests and carry them with us.

  • A yearly gathering

    An evening of worship and sharing to meet the people you support [to confirm].

Give monthly

Frequently asked questions

Can I change or cancel my monthly gift?

Yes, at any time and with no questions asked, from your Zeffy account or by writing to us.

Is there a minimum amount?

No gift is too small. We suggest $10 a month, but every amount is welcome.

Will I get a tax receipt?

A yearly receipt covering all your gifts will be issued [if registered with the CRA — to confirm].

Join the people who keep the light on

Through prayer, a gift or your time: every act counts and every heart is welcome.
